title: Workflow Promotion (absent on 12 SP9): server fault, ErrorQuestion answered no
exercises: 12 SP9 has no Workflow Promotion ItemType, so a dummy id pins the levels-1 request shape and the failure path: the type lookup finds no ItemType, the engine reports 'Error of exporting Item' and asks the ErrorQuestion, answered no (abort the package). A second package is in the run. The success branch stays covered by the spec and a unit test.
